description: Na₄VHO₅ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnma space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.82 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to one H and six O atoms to form distorted NaHO₆ pentagonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent NaHO₆ pentagonal bipyramids, corners with four equivalent VO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent NaH₂O₆ hexagonal bipyramids, and faces with two equivalent NaH₂O₆ hexagonal bipyramids. The Na-H bond length is 2.47 Å. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.56 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to two equivalent H and six O atoms to form distorted NaH₂O₆ hexagonal bipyramids that share corners with four equivalent VO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent NaHO₆ pentagonal bipyramids, faces with two equivalent NaH₂O₆ hexagonal bipyramids, and faces with two equivalent NaHO₆ pentagonal bipyramids. Both Na-H bond lengths are 2.46 Å. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.68 Å. V is bonded to four O atoms to form VO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaH₂O₆ hexagonal bipyramids and corners with four equivalent NaHO₆ pentagonal bipyramids. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.74-1.76 Å. H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to three Na and one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.97 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one V atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to six Na and one H atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one V atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to five Na and one V atom.
